  m_Sigma+  =  m_Lambda + Phi_12  =  1189     (PDG 1189.4, 0.03%)
  m_Xi0     =  m_Sigma + (2^Phi_6 - q)  =  1314  (PDG 1314.9, 0.07%)

ETA-PRIME:

  m_eta'/m_eta  =  Phi_6/mu  =  7/4  =  1.75

NEUTRINO MASS SUM (within current PDG bound):
